scenes.note: The warning is ancient. Arcana or History DC 12 can help identify root-and-fire imagery. The three hidden latches are at D-22, D-26, and D-28.

checks.failure: Take 1 HP damage, but get across.

scenes.title: Calling Into the Dark
scenes.note: CLANG ×3, pause, CLANG ×3. Tomas never taught the party a signal; it is a deliberate sound coming from ahead.

scenes.title: Old Cistern
scenes.note: Tomas Vale is physically found in the old cistern, holding the hammer used for the three-clang signal.

scenes.title: The Collapse
scenes.note: Orange glassy residue indicates magical heat. If Clue A was discovered, it resembles Ember Core material. This is Clue D. Hidden latch 2 is here.

checks.success: Identify magical heat; connect the residue to Ember Core material if Clue A is known. Clue D.

scenes.title: Tomas Vale
scenes.note: Tomas first asks, “Did you open the door?” He describes the side passage, collapse, carved chamber, roots and fire, and creature movement. Give H-03 Tomas’s Sketch.

scenes.title: Searching the Cistern
scenes.note: Searching the cistern reveals I-01 Ancient Bronze Medallion and hidden latch 3. The medallion has no immediate mechanical power and has an approximate antique value of 5 gp.

scenes.title: Getting Tomas Out
scenes.note: Tomas: AC 10, HP 4. He avoids combat and warns that the creature may block the return route.

scenes.title: First Sight of the Crawler
scenes.note: Use the corrected Ember-Root Crawler statistics. It resists fire, retreats at 6 HP or fewer, and begins agitated if the roots were harmed.

scenes.title: Return Route Changes
scenes.note: Use the illustrated DM scene below for read-aloud text and details. The corrected table kit and final correction panels take priority over older illustration text.

scenes.title: Carved Chamber
scenes.note: Nature DC 10 or Arcana DC 11 reveals Clue E. Removing I-02 uses Sleight of Hand DC 10; failure deals 1 fire damage but still obtains the fragment.

checks.success: Understand roots and Ember interaction; Clue E.
Understand roots and Ember interaction; Clue E.

checks.failure: Take 1 fire damage; still obtain the fragment.

scenes.title: Combat
scenes.note: Normal combat. Do not focus-fire downed characters. Driving the Crawler away counts as victory.

scenes.title: Calming the Crawler
scenes.note: With H-01, Nature or Animal Handling DC 11. Without it, DC 13 or a suitable creative magical approach. Success records CRAWLER SPARED.

checks.failure: Without H-01 use DC 13 or appropriate creative magic.

scenes.title: Retreating
scenes.note: Group challenge: 3 successes before 2 failures, DC 10. Failure still permits escape; each character takes 1 damage.

checks.failure: Still escape; each character takes 1 damage.

scenes.title: Using the Environment
scenes.note: Cistern water cools Ember material; rope or debris can obstruct or redirect; bright light can help; fire agitates the Crawler; cold suppresses Ember effects for one round. A strong plan can resolve the encounter without attacks.

scenes.title: After the Crawler
scenes.note: Use the illustrated DM scene below for read-aloud text and details. The corrected table kit and final correction panels take priority over older illustration text.

scenes.title: Choice at the Door
scenes.note: With all three latches found, the central disk can rotate. Let the players decide; changing scenes does not automatically decide or reveal anything.

scenes.title: If They Open the Door
scenes.note: The door opens only a few inches. Green light, a tremendous creak, heat, and recoiling roots are visible. An inner collapse blocks entry. Record DOOR OPENED. H-04 Ancient Sigil Rubbing becomes available.

scenes.title: Leaving the Door Sealed
scenes.note: The door stays completely closed. Record DOOR SEALED. Do not reveal what lies beyond it.

scenes.title: Back to the Surface
scenes.note: Use the illustrated DM scene below for read-aloud text and details. The corrected table kit and final correction panels take priority over older illustration text.

scenes.title: Reporting to Emberthane
scenes.note: Emberthane is Master of Arms, not Aurelion’s ruler. The debrief is in his private workshop/office. His opening is “Tell me everything.”

scenes.title: Ending A — Emberthane Trusted
scenes.note: Record EMBERTHANE TRUST +1. Base reward: 10 gp and 75 XP per character, or use the campaign’s milestone step instead of XP. Do not award the base reward again for later endings.

scenes.title: Ending B — Keeping Secrets
scenes.note: Use the illustrated DM scene below for read-aloud text and details. The corrected table kit and final correction panels take priority over older illustration text.

scenes.title: Ending C — Eastern Gardens
scenes.note: The contact is Lio Fen, not a new High Steward. “Then it has started sooner than we feared.” If earned through protecting roots and/or sparing the Crawler, award I-03 Verdant Favor and record LIVING ACCORD TRUST +1. No extra 10 gp here.

scenes.title: Ending D — Confronting Emberthane
scenes.note: Persuasion DC 12 secures a three-day suspension of Ember experiments. On failure, Emberthane only reduces them. Record EMBER EXPERIMENTS QUESTIONED.

S6-01 - Adventure Setup & Packing Checklist

BRING TO THE TABLE

PRINT & PREPARE
• Print C-01 character sheets as needed.
• Print map tiles at 100% / Actual Size so the
production grid remains 1 inch.
• Cut/organize H-01-H-04 and I-01-I-03.
• Print and cut Step 6 cards, trackers, markers,
and tokens. Laminate reusable pieces if desired.
MAP REVEAL ORDER
M-01A The Descent
Reveal at D-14
M-01B Old Hall
Reveal at D-17
M-02A Maintenance Passage
Reveal at D-18
M-02B Cracked Alcove
Reveal at D-22
M-03A Collapsed Passage
Reveal at D-23
M-03B Cistern
Reveal at D-25
M-04A Carved Chamber
Reveal at D-32
BEFORE PLAYERS ARRIVE
• Review D-00 through D-04 and keep S6-02 through S6-05 within reach.
• Give players only their character sheets and any beginner action cards you want visible.
• Keep maps, H-01-H-04, I-01-I-03, NPC/monster tokens, and surprises behind the DM screen.
• Prepare P-01 as the opening shared visual. The DM controls all Player Visual Book
navigation.
• Keep a blank recap sheet and consequence tracker ready for the end of the session.
• Teaching reminder: players never need to choose page numbers. Ask what their characters
do, adjudicate normally, then route to the closest logical scene.

THREE DOOR LATCHES

Eastern Wall

FAILURE-FORWARD REMINDERS
• Do not roll for obvious actions.
• A failed check should usually cost time, HP, position, or certainty - not stop the
adventure.
• Players can invent actions not listed. Use the closest sensible check or simply allow a
good plan.
• The physical clues can be discovered in different orders; do not explain their meaning
for the players.

S6-04 - NPC Quick Reference
Correct roles and roleplay cues
Lord Pyrrhos Emberthane
Role: Master of Arms
Personality: Pragmatic, controlled, authoritative.
Knows:
Knows stonework is ancient, Ashen-like markings
exist, and Ember Cores may be connected. Wants
Tomas rescued and secrecy maintained.
Limits:
Does not know about the living roots, the hidden
side passage, or what lies beyond the door.
Cue:
'Aurelion survives because someone is willing to
make hard choices.'
Tomas Vale
Role: 32-year-old castle mason
Personality: Curious, frightened, resourceful.
Knows:
Found the maintenance passage, saw the carved
chamber, became trapped after the collapse,
heard/saw the creature.
Limits:
Cannot explain the root-and-flame system.
Cue:
First question: 'Did you open the door?'
Lio Fen
Role: Living Accord messenger
Personality: Quiet, careful, observant.
Knows:
Warns against harming living roots and against
giving Emberthane everything. Gives H-01 if
accepted.
Limits:
Does not name Tharion Greenward during the
initial meeting.
Cue:
Speak softly; imply concern rather than command.
Sergeant Mara Venn
Role: Emberthane's guard
Personality: Loyal, disciplined, visibly unnerved.
Knows:
Knows a castle worker disappeared and the matter
is being kept quiet.
Limits:
Does not volunteer Emberthane's private
suspicions.
Cue:
If pressed: 'One of the castle workers
disappeared. That's all I'm saying.'
Orris Dane
Role: Emberthane's quieter guard
Personality: Restrained, watchful, professional.
Knows:
Supports Mara and Emberthane's security around the mission.
Limits:
Offers little unless directly asked.
Cue:
Use short answers and attentive body language.

S6-05 - Ember-Root Crawler Combat Card
Fight - Calm - Retreat - Environment
STAT BLOCK
• AC 12   |   HP 18   |   Speed 25 ft.
• STR +2  DEX +1  CON +2  INT -3  WIS +1  CHA -2
• Resistance: fire
• Root Lash: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., 1d6+2
bludgeoning
• Ember Spit: recharge 5-6, +3 to hit, range
20/60, 1d6 fire
• At 6 HP or fewer, the Crawler retreats.
• If ROOTS HARMED, it begins agitated.
D-33 FIGHT
• Run normal combat.
• It does not focus-fire downed PCs.
• Driving it away counts as victory.
D-34 CALM
• With H-01: Nature or Animal Handling DC
11.
• Without H-01: DC 13, or suitable creative
magic.
• Success: CRAWLER SPARED.
D-35 RETREAT
• Group challenge: 3 successes before 2
failures, DC 10.
• Failure still escapes; each character
takes 1 damage.
D-36 ENVIRONMENT
• Cistern water cools Ember material.
• Rope/debris can obstruct; bright light can
help; fire angers it.
• Cold suppresses Ember effects for one
round.
• A strong plan can resolve the encounter
without attacks.
All four approaches reconnect at D-37 - After the Crawler.

S6-07 - Beginner Action Cards
Common options - never a complete menu
ATTACK
Make a weapon attack or an attack
that uses an attack roll.
Roll d20 + attack bonus; on a hit,
roll damage.
DASH
Gain extra movement equal to your
Speed for this turn.
Useful for reaching safety or closing
distance.
DISENGAGE
Your movement does not provoke
opportunity attacks for the rest
of this turn.
Useful when leaving melee.
DODGE
Focus on defense until the start
of your next turn.
Attacks you can see have disadvantage;
you have advantage on Dex saves while
able to act.
HELP
Assist another creature with a
task or attack when the rules
allow.
Describe how you help; the DM applies
the appropriate benefit.
HIDE
Try to become hidden when the
situation allows.
The DM decides if hiding is possible,
usually followed by Dex (Stealth).
READY
Prepare an action for a
perceivable trigger.
Choose trigger + response; carrying it
out uses your reaction.
SEARCH
Look carefully for something.
The DM chooses the appropriate check,
often Perception or Investigation.
USE ITEM
Use an object or item when an
action is required.
The item or DM determines the exact
action.
SPELL / MAGIC
Cast a spell or use a magical
feature.
Follow its range, target, save/attack,
duration, and concentration rules.
MOVE
Move up to your Speed.
Movement is normally separate from
your Action.
MY IDEA!
Try something not printed on a
card.
Tell the DM what your character wants
to do. Creative plans are part of D&D.
